title: Labour minister ordered intelligence report on journalists
summary: Exclusive: Material gathered was personally given to Josh Simons when chair of pro-Starmer thinktank, say sources A Labour minister commissioned and reviewed an intelligence report on journalists investigating the thinktank that helped propel Keir Starmer to power, the Guardian has learned. The research was ordered and subsequently reviewed by Josh Simons, now a minister in the Cabinet Office, when he was chair of Labour Together, according to sources and documents seen by the Guardian.
